cohort: Women with no prior vaginal delivery, undergoing a TOLAC and delivering a singleton small for gestational age (SGA) neonate at term (n=255)
finding: Maternal height and epidural administration were positively associated with TOLAC success, while hypertensive disorders were negatively associated with TOLAC success.
mod_finding: For women with no prior vaginal delivery, epidural administration was positively associated with successful vaginal birth of small for gestational age neonates.
